tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal ye shes kyi mgon po brgyad kyi phrin las dngos grub 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

dpal ye shes kyi mgon po brgyad kyi phrin las dngos grub 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo| |gzod nas rab zhi khro sdang rnams spangs kyang*// gdug pa 'dul slad 'jigs rung khro bo'i tshul// dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i khrag gis myos pa'i gar// sa gsum g.yo mdzad de la bdag 'dud do// 'dir mgon po brgyad kyi dbang thob cing dam tshig la gnas pa'i sngags pas/ dur khrod la sogs par bris sku'i mdun du/ gtor ma sman raka mchod pa sogs mthong rgyud lag len ltar bshams la/ stan bde bar skyabs sems sngon du btang nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa lhan cig skyes pa'i skur gsal bar gyur/ sman mchod/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hes bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i ā las thod pa mtshan dang ldan pa'i nang gi dbus dang phyogs bzhir/ mū bi go shu ra las dri chu dri chen klad pa byang sems rak+ta rnams hūm̐ oṃ khaṃ aṃ trāṃ gyis mtshan pa'i steng du/ na go ku ha ta las phyugs chen ba glang khyi dang glang chen rta sha rnams las/ hūm̐ lāṃ bāṃ pāṃ tāṃ gyis mtshan pa rang gi sna bug gi rlung bus pas yaṃ la phog rlung g.yos/ raṃ las me sbar bas thod pa dros rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol bas 'bag btsog nyes pa'i dri ma thams cad lbu ba'i tshul du phyir lud/ rlangs pa hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ gsum mthing dmar dkar ba brtsegs pa las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rigs lnga yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas/ ra sa yā na dang rgya mtsho'i bdud rtsi la sogs pa bkug thod pa'i bdud rtsi la thim zhing*/ yi ge gsum yang 'od du zhu ba 'dres pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi a mṛ tar gyur/ oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ lan gsum/ rak+ta bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhan+dha rlon pa skra'i ba dan 'phyar ba'i nang du/

dgra bgegs gdug pa can bsgral ba'i rak+ta dang gzhan yang rgyu gnyis rkyen gsum sbyar ba'i rak+ta'i rba klong 'khrugs shing khrag lbu nam mkhar 'phyo ba/ gsang ba drag po'i dam rdzas bla na med par gyur/ oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ lan gsum/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rlung me thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i dung chen stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang du sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga gtso bor gyur pa'i bza' bca' btung ba ldag zhib 'dod pa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ ma hā ba ling+ta te dz+wa ba ling+ta ba la ba te ma hā sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ lan gsum/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las phyi'i mchod pa rnams bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i snod du gtsang mar sbyar ba'i mchod pa dang*/ nang gi mchod pa rnams thod pa'i nang du dur khrod kyi rdzas las byung ba thams cad kyang*/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug pa/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo mtha' yas pa nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ nas/ shapada'i bar sbyar/ sngon gtor sman mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba de wa/ nā ga /yak+ṣa/ rak+ṣa sa/ bhu ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsā/ un+mā da/ a pa sma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya dā ya i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+nan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya the baṃ/ ya thaiṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ pi ba tha/ dzi gh+ra tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kārta ya sat+su khaṃ bi shud+dha ya sa hā yi kaṃ bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gsum dang*/ lha klu gnod sbyin srin po bgegs// yi dwags sha za smyo rjed byed// mkha' 'gro mkha' 'gro ma la sogs// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bdag cag nad med tshe dbang phyug /dpal grags skal bzang longs spyod thob// rnam bzhi'i las kyi dngos grub stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dus min 'chi dang nad gdon bgegs// rmi lam mtshan ngan byad stems sogs// med par mdzod la 'jig rten khams// bde zhing lo legs 'bru dang chos// dge legs bsam don 'grub par mdzod// ces 'bul/

rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ steng thams cad rdo rje'i gur khang*/ 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ logs kun tu rdo rje'i ra ba dang dra ba dang rdo rje'i gur dang*/ de'i nang du rdo rje'i bla bre dang phyi rol du mtshon cha sna tshogs pa dang*/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar bas bar med du khyab pas rnam pa thams cad du bgegs dang bral ba'i bdag nyid can du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes srung 'khor bsgom/ bdag bskyed ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis gzung ba dang 'dzin pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bcug cing*/ bdag nyid kyang 'od gsal bde ba chen po nam mkha' ltar gyur pa'i ngang las/ srung 'khor gyi dbus su bh+rūṃ las rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa'i lhun po chen po'i steng du/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i gdan la/ rang sems hūm̐ mthing kha 'od 'bar ba las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte ba hūm̐ mthing nag gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor bcas mchod cing byin rlabs bsdus/ khams gsum pa'i sems can thams cad kyi rgyud sbyangs nas he ru ka'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus sa bon phyag mtshan la thim zhing yongs su gyur pa las/ 'jigs dus kyi gdan la/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa sku mdog sngo sangs zhal 'dzum zhing khro tshul mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum 'gyur zhing smin ma dang sma ra ag tshom dmar ser/ dbu skra ral pa'i cod pan bcings pa'i rtse mor nor bu/ mdun du sna tshogs rdo rje/ g.yon du zla ba thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rus chen gyi phyag rgya lnga dang thal bas byugs pa/ dar dpyangs g.yo zhing stag gi sham thabs grol ba g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa'i pang du yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo rtsa zhal khro chags spyan gsum/

rna ltag g.yas su phag zhal nag po kha gdangs pa skra sil bu thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ thod pa'i dum bu'i ska rags can g.yas rdo rje gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag bcas yab la 'khyud pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang g.yas yab la 'khril ba/ phyogs bzhi'i 'dab mar mi ro'i gdan la/ mdun du mkha' 'gro ma mthing ga /g.yon du mdzes ma ljang gu/ rgyab tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ g.yas su gzugs can ma ser mo rnams mchod cing spyan gsum skra grol nam mkha'i mdog can phyag rgya lngas spras pa/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod khrag zhabs gnyis g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa/ gru mo kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsgrengs pa/ mtshams kyi pad 'dab bzhi la bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pa'i steng du/ sha lngas gang ba'i thod pa dang bcas pa gsal ba/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma la āḥdamar po/ snying gar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya smin mtshams su bskor zhing*/ pheṃ/ rang gi snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs dang dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs| oṃ badz+ra wī ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ waṃ she= mṛ taṃ ge= mu rañdze= hā s+ya= lā s+ya= gī ti= nṛ t+yai= puṣ+pe= dhū pe= dī paṃ= gan+dhe= oṃ rū pa badz+ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ra sa= spar+she= dharma dhā tu= dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa rnams dam tshig pa la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang gi lhar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis bum pa dkar po bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las yab la mi bskyod pa/ yum la rnam snang*/

mkha' 'gro ma bzhi la rin 'byung gis rgyas btab/ dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur par bsam/ phyi'i mchod pa ni/ oṃ shrī tsakra sam+ba raṃ sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas/ shapada'i bar dang*/ gong ltar rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ nang mchod ni/ sman bdud rtsi'i thig le gtor mar 'bul zhing*/ bka' drin 'khor med rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*// rdo rje 'chang dang klu sgrub dril bu pa// dzā lan+dha ra nag po spyod pa dang*// til+li pa dang nā ro kar+ṇa ri// rdo rje gdan pa 'jigs med 'byung gnas zhabs// rtsa mi rga lo dpal ldan phag gru pa// chos rje spyan snga bcu gnyis dbang bsod pa// grags pa shes rab tshul rgyal grags rdor ba// 'dren mchog bla ma blo bzang rin bzang zhabs// bsod nams bkra shis gnam lcags me 'bar dang*// mchog grub rgyal po chos kyi grags pa sogs// rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhal du 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+ba raṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye oṃ āḥ hūm̐/ oṃ ḍā ki nā+e+i ye oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ lā me oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ khan+ḍa ro he oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ rū pi ṇī ye oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ma hā kā lā kā lī ye oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes phul zhing rang gis myang*/ gsang mchod ni/ bcom ldan 'das yab yum bde ba chen po'i rjes su chags pas bskul te snyoms par zhugs pas lha thams cad bde ba chen pos tshim par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes 'khyud rgya bya/ de kho na'i mchod pa ni/ oṃ sarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dhaḥshū n+ya tā ma hā dz+nyā na badz+ri' bha wa shud+dhaḥ.ā t+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod la ngo bo nyid bsgom/ bstod pa ni rdor dril 'dzin pas/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bī re shā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma hā kalpāg+ni san+ni bhā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/

oṃ dzā ṭa ma ku ṭot+ka ṭā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ daṃṣ+ṭā ka ra lo gra bhi ṣa na mu khā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sa ha sra bhu dza bhā su rā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ par shu pā shod+yā ta shū la kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dhā ri ṇe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ byā gh+rā dzi nāṃ wa ra dha rā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma hā dhūmrān+dhā kā ra wa pu ṣā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa tī badz+ra wā rā hī baṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ār+ya a pa rā dzi te trai lokya mā te ma hā bīd+ye shwa ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sarba bhū ta bha yā ba he ma hā badz+re huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra ā sa ne a dzi te a pa rā dzi te wa sh+yaṃ ka ri ni tra bh+rā ma ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sho ṣa ni ro ṣa ṇi kro dha ni ka rā li ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ trā sa ni mā ra ṇi pra bhe da ni a pa rā dza ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bi dza ye dzaṃ bha ni s+t+waṃ bha ni mo ha ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra wā rā hī ma hā yo gi nī kā me shwa ri kha ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces bstod/ dag pa dran zhing nga rgyal brtan pa ni/ shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te/ /he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid// ru ni tshogs pa dang bral ba ste// ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o// a ni thabs mchog bde chen khrag 'thung dpal| |haṃ ni shes rab stong nyid phag mo yum/ /chos kun gdod nas rab zhi ma skyes pa// skye med ngang las rang shar lha nga'o/ /shrī he ru ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing don bsgom/ bzlas pa ni dung chen gyi phreng bar/ oṃ hrīḥpad+ma narte shwa ri hūm̐/ zhes nyer gcig gis byin brlabs te/ rang 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dbus su hūm̐ mthing nag gi mthar snying po dang nye snying gi sngags kyis bskor ba las sngags phreng gnyis pa 'phros/ rlung dang lhan cig rang gi sna bug g.yon nas thon/ khams gsum pa'i sems can 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba'i sna bug g.yas par zhugs/

snying kha'i nyi mar hūm̐ la sngags kyis bskor ba la thim/ slar de las sngags phreng 'phros rlung dang bsdongs sna bug g.yon pa nas thon/ rang gi sna bug g.yas par zhugs/ thugs ka'i sngags phreng la thim par gyur par bsam la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ḍā ki ni dzā la sam+ba raṃ swā hā/ snying po'o// oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ| nye snying ngo*// yum dang mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dbus su yum la baṃ gyi mthar sngags gnyis dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma/ lā ma/ dum skyes ma/ gzugs can ma bzhi la rim bzhin ṭaṃ laṃ khaṃ raṃ bzhi la rang sngags kyis bskor bar dmigs la/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces snying po dang*/ nye snying ngo*// oṃ ḍā ki nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ lā me huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ khan+ḍa ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ rū pi ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'o// de ltar gtso 'khor yab dang*/ de rjes yum/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi rnams la bzlas pa go rim bzhin ci rigs pa bya'o// bzlas pas skyo na bsdu rim ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis srung 'khor rnams mkha' 'gro ma bzhi la thim/ mkha' 'gro bzhi yum la/ yum yab la/ yab thugs ka'i hūm̐ la hūm̐ yig zhabs kyu khog pa mgo bo zla tshes thig le nā da la thim zhing nā da yang mi dmigs pa'i ngang du dar cig bzhag /slar yang rang nyid thun mtshams kyi he ru ka sngon po/ phyag gnyis rdor dril 'dzin pa rgyan chas dang ldan pa'i dpa' bo gcig par gsal bar gyur par dmigs/ de yang bde mchog gtso bo dang mgon po zhor sgrub byed na thun bsdus nas gtor ma phyi nang 'bul ba gzhan ltar bya/ mgon po gtsor sgrub byed na bde mchog bdag bskyed kyi phyed tsam byas nas mdun bskyed sgrub pa yin no// mchan// mdun bskyed bsgrub pa ni/

oṃ khan+ḍa ro hes bsangs/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du rdo rje'i brag ri mtshon cha gzengs pa lta bu gnag cing rtsub pa mtho zhing rgya che la sra ba brtan pa'i steng du/ dur khrod kyi bkod pa 'jigs su rung ba/ khrag gis sbags pa'i ro langs dang keng rus mang po ha ha hi hi'i nga ro sgrog cing gar byed pa/ las kyi shan pa pho nya'i tshogs rnams kyis nyams pa rnams 'gugs shing 'ching sgrol gsod gcod kyi las byed pa/ khyung nag dang*/ dur bya/ bzhad dang*/ bya rog /'ug pa la sogs pa 'dab chags ma rungs pa du ma lding zhing 'phyo ba/ seng stag /dom dred/ 'phar spyang*/ gcan gzan gdug pa can sna tshogs rgyug 'dral dang ngu 'bod 'byin pa/ mi ro dang rta ro la sogs pa bsregs pa dang gsal shing la bskyon pa dang*/ 'thor ba dang*/ bam pa dang*/ rul ba dang*/ rus gong du gyur pa sogs kyi sa gzhi gcal du bkram pa/ gzhan yang rnal 'byor pa dang lha klu phyogs skyong zhing skyong 'dre srin sha za dregs pa mang po dang*/ ri dang mchod rten me chu sprin shing la sogs pa/ dur khrod kyi bkod pa thams cad yongs su tshang ba/ steng na sprin nag 'khrigs shing glog 'khyug 'brug gi sgra skad drag po sgrog bzhin du gnam lcags kyi lce dang rdo rje'i ser ba bab pas dgra bgegs thams cad kyi mgo snying 'gas pa/ phyogs thams cad du me rlung dmar nag drag tu 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje nag po rtse mo bcu gnyis pa'i lte bar sna tshogs pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru bh+rūṃ dang keṃ las dur khrod 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang chen po gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa thod pa skam rlon brtsegs shing khrag chen gyis sbyar ba klad chen dang zhag gis zhal ba byas pa/ sgo bzhir keng rus kyi ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i zhing chen bsnol ba'i rta babs bang rim bzhi pa'i steng mi ro'i rgyal mtshan 'phyar ba/

mi lpags rlon pa'i 'dod snam la mchod pa'i lha mo mang po gnas pas mchod pa/ zhing gi pha gu la mi mgos brgyan pa'i steng du mi'i rgyu ma'i dra ba phyed pa'i dbus dang mtshams rnams su snying gi pho long 'phyang ba/ mchog chen gyi shar bu la keng rus kyis spras pa/ lag pa'i mda' yab can gyi steng rnams su seng stag chu srin la sogs pa'i srog chags gdug pa can gyi rgyal mtshan mang po bsgrengs pa/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du mi ro rengs pa'i ka ba brgyad kyis bteg pa'i steng du lha klu gza' skar gyi ka gdung dang dral lcam gyis phub pa'i rtser/ bdud dang srin po'i tshogs kyi ro spyi'u tshugs su phon por bcings pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor bai ḍūr+ya'i rdo rje sngon po rwa rnam par gdengs pas spras pa/ khang bzang de'i phyi nang thams cad shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba'i nang du/ khrag chen gyi rgya mtsho chen po dmar chil chil khol ba 'dod pa'i yon tan du mas gang ba'i dbus su/ gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo nag po rtsibs bdun pa mu khyud phyi nang lte ba dang bcas pa'i dbus su drag po chos kyi dbyings gru gsum mthing nag kha khyer dang bcas pa'i lte bar| pad+ma sngon po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i ze'u 'brur nyi ma dang dgra bgegs kyi gdan la/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ yig gnyis pa srog rtsol phyir rgyu ba dang bsdongs nas thog ltar chad cing bab pa de nyid rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pas yu ba byas pa'i gri gug lte ba hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa rnams mchod cing byin rlabs bsdus/ sems can thams cad kyi nga yir 'dzin pa'i bdud bsad cing bcom/ dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus sa bon phyag mtshan dang bcas pa la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po rdo rje srin po nag po chen po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ sku mdog char sprin ltar gnag cing 'jigs su rung ba gzi brjid 'bar zhing brjid pa/

sku che zhing yan lag rags pa/ sku gsus shin tu che zhing 'khyil ba/ spyan gsum dmar zlum g.yo zhing 'khrugs pa'i sdang mig bsgrad pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa ljags 'gyur hūm̐ dang a la la ho la sogs pa'i sgra skad sgrog pa/ smin ma dang sma ra ag tshom dmar ser me ltar 'bar zhing g.yo ba/ zhal rnam par 'gyur ba'i nyams can/ ral pa kham nag gyen du 'phyo ba/ thod skam lnga rin po che'i rtse bran can skra mtshams su bcings pa/ thod rlon khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu mi'i rgyu mas sbrel ba'i do shal dang*/ sbrul sngo ljang gi mchod phyir thog dang bcas pa/ phyag g.yas dang pos rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan pa'i gri gug dang*/ g.yon dang pos thod pa khrag dang snying gis bkang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ g.yas gnyis pas ral gri 'debs pa'i tshul dang*/ g.yon gnyis pas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga gdengs pa'i stabs su 'dzin pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan zhing rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang thal chen gyis byugs pa/ sbrul dkar pos skra bcings/ dmar pos mgul rgyan/ ser pos rna cha/ nag pos phyag zhabs kyi gdub bu/ khra bos ska rags dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ stag lpags rlon pas zhabs kyi 'gag yan chad bklubs pa/ zhabs g.yas cung zad 'dor zhing*/ g.yon bskum pa tsan skyil gyis bzhugs pa/ sku las 'phros pa'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba/ gru gsum la mdun du srog bdag /g.yas su tshe bdag /g.yon du 'chi bdag bya rog gi gdong pa can gsum g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag /zla gam g.yas su thugs yum rtsa 'jib ma dmar mo g.yas dang pos ral gri/ zla gam g.yon du yum kā la rā tri nag mo g.yas dang pos gri gug /gnyis ka g.yas gnyis pas tri shū la dang g.yon gnyis mda' gzhu dang dgra mgo 'dzin pa/ mu khyud la mdun du sha za seng gdong g.yas ral gri/ g.yon thod khrag /g.yas skor du mgyogs ma bya rgod kyi gdong can/

myos byed phag gi gdong can/ gsod byed 'ug pa'i gdong can/ 'gugs byed khyi yi gdong can/ skrod byed khwa yi gdong can/ za byed spyang ki'i gdong can/ brlag byed khyung gi gdong can/ 'joms byed stag gi gdong can rnams g.yas gri gug g.yon thod khrag /'khor de dag thams cad sku mdog nag po rngam 'jigs khro gnyer bsdus shing spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa/ ral pa dang smin ma sma ra ag tshom me ltar 'bar ba/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang thod skam gyi dbu rgyan rlon pa'i do shal stag lpags kyi sham thabs zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa'i gar stabs can nyi ma'i gdan dang bcas pa'o// rtsibs bdun la nyi ma'i gdan re rer mdun nas g.yas skor du/ rtsibs dang por myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa/ phyag g.yas gsum gri gug phreng ba ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gsum thod khrag rtse gsum zhags pa/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bi nā ya ka mnan pa/ phyag zhabs sbrul gyis dkris pa/ dpral bar sin+dhu ras mtshan pa/ gnyis par rdo rje gur gyi mgon po/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod khrag thugs kar steng 'og du 'dzin pa'i gru mor rnam 'phrul gyi gaṇ+ḍi bkal ba/ zhabs gnyis mi'u thung gel pa'i stabs can/ gsum par lha chen stobs 'phrog nag po/ sku dang rtsa zhal nag po/ zhal g.yas dkar g.yon dmar steng zhal dud kha/ phyag g.yas dang pos gri gug 'og mas ral gri/ g.yon dang pos thod khrag 'og mas rtse gsum 'dzin pa'i phyag 'gag tu thod pa'i phreng ba dang*/ mchan khung du chang gi bum pa bcug pa/ dgra bgegs kyi gdan la dor stabs can/ bzhi par tsan+dan gyi beng mthing nag phyag g.yas beng chen gsor ba'i tshul dang*/ g.yon lcags par/ dar nag gi 'jol ber dang sag chen yu ring mnabs pa/ zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum dbugs bral la gnas pa/ lnga par dpal mgon ma ning nag po/ g.yas kha ṭ+wāṃ g.yon thod pa snying bcas/ dar nag gi ber gyon pa/

zhabs brkyang bskum gyis mi ro brdzis pa/ drug par stag zhon nag po/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod khrag ber smug gsol zhing stag chen dar ma la chibs pa/ bdun par rnam thos sras drag byed mthing nag /g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa ba dan gyis brgyan pa'i dbyug pa dang*/ g.yon bdud 'dul gyi pū ri bsnams pa/ seṅge sngon po kha gdangs pa'i steng du rol stabs kyis 'gying ba/ bdun ka'ang khro bo'i cha lugs gtum rngam khro gnyer spyan gsum mche gtsigs dpal dang dur khrod kyi chas thams cad kyis brgyan pa rang rang gi yum dang 'khor gyi tshogs dang bcas te rnam par gnas pa'o// sgo yi nang gi khyams kyi shar du nag po stong bya rog gi gdong pa can gri gug dang thod khrag /lhor sha za 'bum seṅge'i gdong pa can ral gri dang thod khrag /nub tu ma mo bye ba nad rkyal la sogs pa thogs pa/ byang du gnod sbyin khri mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa/ phyi'i khyams su phyogs skyong bcu/ rgyal chen bzhi/ 'jigs byed dgu/ lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ gza' chen po brgyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'phrog ma bu lnga brgya la sogs pa/ bka'i lha ma srin sde brgyad/ pho rgyud/ mo rgyud/ klu rgyud gsum gyis bsdus pa'i 'jig rten gyi dregs pa ma rungs pa du mas yongs su bskor bar gyur/ nang gi lha thams cad kyi dpral bar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma drug pa'i lte bar āḥdamar po| thugs kar rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i ste bar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gyur par bsam la/ spyan drang ba ni/ bdag dang mgon po'i thugs kar gnas pa'i hūm̐ las 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can dmar po glog 'khyug pa ltar phyogs bcur 'phros pas ye shes kyi mgon po rnams rang rang gi gnas nas spyan drangs par bsam/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgyas/

oṃ aṣ+ṭa badz+ra ma hā kā lā sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang sbyar ba'i spos bsreg /rol mo du ma'i sgra dang bcas ste/ hūm̐ */ rang bzhin dag pa ma bcos spros dang bral// 'og min lhun rdzogs don dam pho brang nas// gdod nas grub pa ye shes mgon po che// spyan 'dren bzhugs mchod spros pa dang bral yang*// kun rdzob rten 'byung sgyu ma'i rnam rol du// chos dbyings rang byung gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// dpal ldan nā len+d+ra sogs grub pa'i gnas// rgyal bas bsngags pa'i gnas yul dur khrod dang*// rgya mtsho'i 'gram sogs zhing khams rgya mtsho nas// rdo rje srin po rab khros gshegs su gsol// sku gsung thugs sprul bya rog gdong can gsum// dmar nag sbyor dang sgrol ba'i yum chen gsum// sha za nag po mkha' 'gro brgyad la sogs// sprul pa'i 'khor tshogs ma lus gshegs su gsol// myur mdzad mgon po gur mgon gdong bzhi pa// beng chen ma ning stag zhon drag byed bcas// thub pa'i bstan pa srung mdzad nag po che// rang 'khor yum bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// ci bgyi'i bka' nyan pho nya las mkhan tshogs// bka' yi 'khor du gtogs pa'i nag po stong*// sha za 'bum dang ma mo bye bar bcas| |gnod sbyin khri sogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol// yang 'khor phyogs skyong 'jigs byed rgyal chen dang*// lha klu gza' dang rgyu skar 'phrog ma bu// lha srin sde brgyad snang srid dregs pa'i tshogs// bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub phyir gshegs su gsol// oṃ aṣ+ṭa badz+ra ma hā kā lā sa pa ri wā ra ā gats+tsha e h+ye hi sa ma ya dzaḥ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐ */ dur khrod rab 'jigs rngam pa'i gzhal med khang*// brjid pa'i gdan bcas 'dod dgu'i dam rdzas sogs// ma tshang med pa'i gnas mchog dam pa 'dir// rang rang gdan la dgyes par bzhugs su gsol// oṃ aṣ+ṭa badz+ra ma hā kā lā sa pa ri wā ra ā gats+tsha e h+ye hi sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/

dam la bzhag pa ni/ mgon po 'khor bcas kyi mgor rdo rje bzhag /khar a mṛ ta sbyin par bsam la rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bstan la/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥ nag po chen po khyed rnams kyis// sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang dbang dang*// thub mchog shākya'i spyan snga ru// sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba dang*// dam ldan rnal 'byor skyong ba dang*// log 'dren dgra bgegs sgrol ba sogs// ci bgyi'i bka' las mi 'da' zhes// khas blangs srog gi snying po phul// dkyil 'khor gtso mchog de rnams kyis// dam tshig rdo rje spyi bor bzhag /mna' yi btung ba lcer byin pa// ma bsnyel dus 'dir dgongs mdzod la// rnal 'byor bdag gi phrin las sgrubs| |gal te dam las khyod 'da' na// dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rdo rje// mi shigs dam tshig bka'i chad pas// khyod kyi mgo snying rab 'gas shing*// lus sems rdul du brlags nas kyang*// rdo rje'i dmyal bar 'tshed par byed// de bas dam srungs dam nos shig /oṃ aṣ+ṭa badz+ra ma hā kā lā sa pa ri wā ra ā gats+tsha e h+ye hi badz+ra sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭha hūm̐/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐ */ rang rig 'dod nas lha ru dag /gnyis su 'dzin pa 'khrul ba'i blo// 'on kyang rmad byung rten 'brel du// ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas la// mnyam nyid mos pa'i sems kyis ni// brda dang gar gyi phyag bgyi'o// oṃ aṣ+ṭa badz+ra ma hā kā lā sa pa ri wā ra ā gats+tsha e h+ye hi na maḥka ra āt+ma naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi| phyi'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ yan lag brgyad ldan yid 'ong mchod yon ldan// rab gtsang dwangs pa'i zhabs bsil bdud rtsir bskyil// sna tshogs lta sdug chu skyes lang tsho bzhad// grub dang sbyar ba'i bdug pa sprin ltar gtibs// nyi zla'i 'od ltar gsal ba'i sgron me gtams// ngad ldang dri bsung brda yi dri chab bcas// bshos gtsang bza' bca' btung ba yid 'phrog ldan| |rnga dung rol mo dbyangs snyan dang bcas pa'i// phyi'i mchod sprin nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa// mgon po 'khor bcas dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul// oṃ aṣ+ṭa badz+ra mahā kā lā sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/

pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shapad pū dza pra tīts+tsha hoḥ nang gi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ log 'dren gdug pa bsgral ba'i snying khrag dang*// dug chen sbyar ba'i mchod yon rngam pa brjid/ */sna tshogs rak+ta myos byed dang bcas pa'i// zhabs bsil rab 'jigs rgya mtsho'i 'jing ltar 'khyil// dbang po sna lnga'i me tog la sogs pa// gnag pa'i chu skyes lang tsho mi sdug 'dzegs// sha chen 'dre 'jigs lha mig khrag la sogs// sbyar ba'i bdug spos log 'dren 'byer zhing skrod// mkhris chen su ra ga pur la sogs pa// yongs su sbyar ba'i dri chab bku zhing bsnams// sha rus khu khrag 'bru nag las byas pa'i// gdug pa'i bshos bu ri ltar che brjid brtan// thod rnga rkang gling bshug pa'i sgra dbyangs sogs// drag po'i rol mo sa gsum 'dar zhing g.yo// dur khrod nang gi mchod pa dam pa 'di// rdo rje srin po rab 'jigs tshogs la 'bul// bzhes la dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i las mdzod cig |oṃ aṣ+ṭa badz+ra ma hā kā lā sa pa ri wā ra ma hā sh+ma shā na pū dza ar+ghaṃ sogs/ gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ pad+ma can la sogs pa'i phyag rgya lnga// khro mo'i tshul can rjes chags nyams ldan pa// ma hā kā lā'i sku la rab 'khyil nas// mkha' gsang byin rlabs snyoms 'jug srub sbyor gyis// dga' ba bzhi brgyad bcu drug dang ldan pa// nyams su myong bas lha rnams tshim par bgyid// oṃ aṣ+ṭa badz+ra ma hā kā lā sa pa ri wā ra a nu rā ga ṇa pū dza pra tīts+tsha hūm̐/ de kho na'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ lha dang mchod pa rnal 'byor sgrub pa po// gdod nas rnam dag gang yang grub pa med// gnyis med mnyam rol 'du 'bral med pa'i ngang*// yang dag don gyi mchod pa 'di bzhes la// spros med mchog dang dngos grub stsal du gsol// oṃ aṣ+ṭa badz+ra ma hā kā lā sa pa ri wā ra ar+tha sat+ma hā mu dra shū n+ya tā pū dza pra tīts+tsha hoḥ

sman mchod ni/ bdud rtsi mtheb srin gyis thigs gtor 'bul zhing*/ hūm̐ */ mtshan dang ldan pa'i bhan+dha ru// rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar zhing*// myos byed bcud kyi rab sbags pa// ra sa yā na'i mchod pa 'di// rdo rje srin po'i zhal du 'bul// bya rog gdong gsum zhal du 'bul// sbyor sgrol yum gyi zhal du 'bul// sha za mkha' 'gro'i zhal du 'bul// myur mdzad mgon po'i zhal du 'bul// gur gyi mgon po'i zhal du 'bul// stobs 'phrog nag po'i zhal du 'bul// beng 'dzin chen po'i zhal du 'bul// ma ning nag po'i zhal du 'bul// stag zhon mgon po'i zhal du 'bul// drag byed chen po'i zhal du 'bul// nag po stong gi zhal du 'bul// sha za 'bum gyi zhal du 'bul// ma mo bye ba'i zhal du 'bul// gnod sbyin khri yi zhal du 'bul// dpal mgon bdun cu'i zhal du 'bul// snang srid dregs pa'i zhal du 'bul// dam can rgya mtsho'i zhal du 'bul| |oṃ aṣ+ṭa badz+ra ma hā kā lā sa pa ri wā ra sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hiḥ zhes 'bul dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐ */ ljags kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig ni// sku gsung thugs dang rab ldan par// thabs shes mnyam rol phyag rgya mchog /mtha' ltag nyi zla 'bar ba yi// 'od kyis drangs ba'i ra sa yan// myangs bas bde stong zag med thob// a la la ste ngo mtshar che// e ma ho ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ */oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta ra sa yā na kā ya wāka tsit+ta sid+dhi pha la hoḥ zhes mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi blangs pa lcer bzhag /rak+ta'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ skra dang bcas pa'i snod 'jigs pa// yi dwags lhung bzed 'bar ba ru// rgyu gnyis rkyen gsum rab sbyar ba'i// dmar chen rak+ta'i mchod pa ni// lbu phreng srid pa'i rtse mor 'phyo// rba rlabs stong gsum gang bar 'khrugs// lha srung dam ldan dgyes pa skong*// ma rungs 'byung po rlog par byed// rab 'jigs rngam pa'i ru dhī ra// gsang ba'i dam tshig rdzas mchog 'di// khrag 'thung rdo rje'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes rol dgyes tshim dgra bgegs sgrol// oṃ aṣ+ṭa badz+ra ma hā kā lā sa pa ri wā ra ma hā rak+ta la kha raṃ khā hi/

gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ stong gsum dang mnyam dung chen gzhong pa ru// sna tshogs 'bru mtshon dkar mngar dri bzang ldan// myos byed tshogs dang sgron ma lcags kyu lnga// shing thog sna tshogs khur ba la sogs pa// bza' btung ldag zhib bda' zhing bsung ba'i tshogs// ma tshang med pa'i dam rdzas gtor ma 'di// lha chen dpal 'bar nag po'i tshogs la 'bul// maṃ sa ri ltar spungs pa'i gtor ma bzhes// rak+ta mtsho ltar dkyil ba'i gtor ma bzhes// tsit+ta rgyan ltar btsugs pa'i gtor ma bzhes// ba su 'phan ltar phyar ba'i gtor ma bzhes// dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la// thugs dam skong zhing nyams bshags phrin las sgrub// oṃ aṣ+ṭa badz+ra ma hā kā lā sa pa ri wā ra ma hā ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes gtor mar sman raka bran sngar gtor ma byin rlabs ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ hūm̐ hoḥpheṃ/ bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma lha srin sde brgyad yul lha gzhi bdag ma lus pa gtor ma'i mgron du spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma lā ye s+t+waṃ/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ nas/ shapad pra tīts+tsha hūm̐/ bla ma rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i rnam pa/ yi dam rnams kyi ljags phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyi ljags mtshon cha'i rnam pa can 'od kyi sbu gus gtor ma'i ro bcud rnams drangs te gsol bas mnyes shing tshim par gyur/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma/ rdo rje 'chang*/ til+li pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mi la/ sgam po pa/ dpal phag mo gru pa/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po nas bzung*/ rig 'dzin thugs kyi rdo rje'i bar du brgyud pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ badz+ra ā ral+li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ oṃ shrī tsakra sam+ba ra badz+ra wā rā hī ḍā ki lā me khan+ḍa ro he rū pi ṇī sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/

yi dam 'khor lo sdom pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo/ mkha' 'gro ma/ mdzes ma/ dum skyes ma/ gzugs can ma/ dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i zhal du i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gzhan yang dus dgyes gsang gdan sgyu thod dmar nag 'jigs gsum gdong drug bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla med la sogs pa gsang sngags gsar ma'i yi dam gyi lha tshogs ma lus pa'i zhal du i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa/ bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa/ mdo dbang chen po/ dam chos dgongs pa yang zab/ gu ru zhi drag /rta phag dmar nag /dam pa rigs brgya theg pa rim dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sogs pa gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi yi dam rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i zhal du i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ badz+ra ka wu wa wa pa ma hā kā lā ya i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ ma hā kā lā gu ṇa hṛ da trak+shad dzaḥ su tri ya ma du dzaḥ ma hā kā lī kā la rā tri rak+ta de wī singha mu kha/ ghid+da mu khi/ ga ru ḍa mu khi/ ka kā mu khi/ ul+lu mu khi/ bā rā ha mu khi/ shwa na mu khi/ shriṃ gā la mu khi/ byā gh+ra mu khi/ ma hā kā lī karma ma hā kā lā sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ma hā kā lā ya/ shā sa na sogs/ mā ra ya i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa rdo rje nag po chen po bya rog gi mtshan can/ sku gsung thugs sprul srog tshe 'chi bdag bya rog gi gdong pa can/ thugs yum rtsa 'jib ma/ yum chen tsaṇ+ḍi ka /sha za seng ge'i gdong pa can/ mkha' 'gro ma bya rgod khyung dang khwa 'ug pa phag dang khyi spyang ki stag gi gdong pa can rnams kyi zhal du i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ ma hā kā lā k+ṣiṃ k+ṣe tra pā la bigh+nān bi nā ya ka /badz+ra ma hā kā lā ya/ ma hā kā lā kā lā bi kā la rā tri ta/

ma hā kā lā du beṃ ni dzaḥ ma hā kā lā ga ṇa gu h+ya raṃ sid+dhi/ ma hā kā lā tri yaṃ dzaḥ/ ma hā kā lā bai shra ma ṇā ya sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi| dpal ye shes kyi mgon po myur mdzad phyag drug pa/ rdo rje gur gyi mgon po/ lha chen stobs 'phrog chen po/ tsan+dan gyi beng*/ dpal mgon ma ning nag po/ gtum chen stag zhon mgon po/ rnam thos sras drag byed chen po rnams rang rang gi yum 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ ma hā kā lī karma ma hā kā lā i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bka'i 'khor du gtogs pa'i nag po stong*/ sha za 'bum/ ma mo bye ba/ gnod sbyin khri dang bcas pa'i zhal du i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ sarba dharma pā la i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ phyogs skyong bcu/ rgyal chen bzhi/ 'jigs byed dgu/ lha chen brgyad/ klu chen brgyad/ gza' chen brgyad/ rgyu skar nyer brgyad/ 'phrog ma ma bu lnga brgya/ snang srid kyi lha ma srin pho mo klu gsum gyis bsdus pa ma lus pa'i zhal du i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gzhan yang bstan srung khyad par can/ a phyi sna nam bza'/ dbyings phyug chos kyi sgrol ma/ ye shes dam tshig dbang dang las kyi mkha' 'gro/ thugs sprul za gsod 'phrog byed/ phrin las kyi sprul pa khro mo dmar mo/ mkha' 'gro ma srog gi spu gri/ a ma snying bsgul ma/ sha za dmar nag stong*/ 'khor srog shan 'bum mkha' 'gro ma bye ba'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i zhal du i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bka' srung e ka dzā ṭi/ gza' bdud rā hu la/ dam can rdo rje legs pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bka' srung mi bsrun gza' klu ha ra nag po 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhing skyong kun dga' gzhon nu yab yum/ las mkhan dus mtshan pho mo/

dregs pa sde brgyad kyi tshogs dang bcas pa'i zhal du i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gza' bdud chen po rā hu la/ gza' chen brgyad/ gdong mo bzhi/ gza' skar sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs rnams kyi zhal du i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rgyal chen pe har sku lnga/ chos skyong gnod sbyin rtsi dmar ba/ lha chen tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can/ skyes bu badz+ra thig le rtsal la sogs pa dam can bka' srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs ma lus pa'i zhal du i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung mar bcas pa khyed rnams kyis gtor ma dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po 'di bzhes nas tshims shing rangs pa dang mnyes par gyur nas/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad gnas skabs su phan pa dang bde legs tshe bsod dpal 'byor snyan grags phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ nad gdon bar gcod 'gal 'tshe byad phur rbod gtong 'jigs pa chen po than ltas rmi lam mtshan ngan lo zla zhag dus kyi skag ngan log 'dren mi mthun pa gnod pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang*/ mthar thug rigs drug pa rdo rje 'chang khrag 'thung he ru ka chen po'i go 'phang dam pa myur du thob par mdzod cig /gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa zhabs pad yun ring du 'tsho zhing gzhes pa dang*/ phyogs bcu'i dge 'dun rnams thugs mthun zhing 'khor lo gnyis kyi bya bas dus 'da' ba dang*/ sems can thams cad bde zhing skyid par mdzod cig /khyad par du rig 'dzin sngags 'chang rnal 'byor pa bdag gis ci bcol ba'i phrin las rab 'byams zhi rgyas dbang drag la sogs pa thams cad yid la bsam zhing bcol ba tsam gyis thogs pa med pa 'grub par mdzod cig sa ma ya hoḥ /gzhan yang yul rigs kyi gzhi bdag /gnas rigs kyi srung ma thams cad gtor mas tshims nas bdag cag gi mthun pa bsgrub pa'i grogs su che bar gyur cig

/gzhan yang khams gsum rigs drug skye gnas bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad kyang gtor ma 'dod yon lnga dang ldan pa 'dis tshims nas myur du thar pa dam pa thob par gyur cig /ces rdor thal kha bye ba'i rgyas/ oṃ kha kha sogs sngar gtor bsngos kyi gtor ma'i sngags kyang lan gsum rol mo dang bcas pas brjod de/ bstod pa ni skabs 'dir gtso bo rkang brgyad dang byang shar nags 'dabs ma bcas kyang 'don/ slar yang*/ hūm̐ */ chos kun gdod nas spros bral rnam dag kyang*// sna tshogs 'gro ngor rten 'byung sgyu 'phrul gar// zhi dang drag po chu zla'i gzugs brnyan bzhin// gang dmigs der snang sprul pa'i sku la bstod// rgyal ba kun 'dus mkha' 'gro dra ba sdom// khro ba rab spangs rtag tu nyer zhi yang*// 'dul dka' 'dul phyir slar yang nyid sprul pa// rdo rje khrag 'thung dpal la bdag bstod do// khyod ni sangs rgyas kun gyi bstan srung ste// rgyal ba mar me mdzad dus khyod kyi rgyud// g.yo dang zil gyis gnon pa'i phyag rgya yis// bdud kyi bu bzhi bu mo dang bcas pa// rgyal ba de drung sems bskyed srung mar bskos| |de yang khyod mthu lags kyi bdag bstod do// gser thub dus su klu yi dgra dar bas// de yis de 'dul dgongs kyang ma thul tshe// lag na rdo rjes khyod kyi rgyud gdams rnams| |'phur 'gro'i gnas nas spyan drangs klu rnams btul// de yang khyod mthu lags kyi bdag bstod do// 'khor ba 'jig dus gnod sbyin mched brgyad kyis// bstan la gnod tshe ston pas chos bstan kyang*// ma dul gsang ba'i bdag po'i thugs ka nas// nag po khyod thon gnod sbyin 'khor bcas btul// de yang khyod mthu lags kyi bdag bstod do// 'od srung dus su lha mo mched brgyad kyis// 'jig rten khams kun phung bar byas nas kyang*// nyan rang rnams kyang log pa'i chos la btsud// ma tshud pa rnams phab cing bsad pa'i tshe// rdo rje thogs pas khyod mngags lha mo brgyad// dbang bsdus bran khol bstan pa gsal bar byas// de yang khyod mthu lags kyi bdag bstod do// 'dren pa shāka thub zhing 'dir byon nas kyang*// bdud bzhi btul tshe gsang bdag thugs ka nas// khyod sprul bdud kyi dmag bzlog bar chad bsrungs// de tshe ston pas rang nyid 'das nas lo// bzhi brgya lon tshe nag po chen po'i sku// dngos su byon nas lung ston sgrub pa po'i// bar gcod sel zhes lung bstan mdzad pa'ang khyod// khrag 'thung dpal 'bar che la bdag bstod do// sku mdog nag po bzod dka' gzi brjid 'bar// zhal bsgrad mche gtsigs ljags 'gyur hūm̐ sgra 'byin// dmar zlum spyan gsum g.yo 'khrugs me ltar 'bar// zur gyis lta dang rnam par bsgrad pa'i tshul// thod skam lnga 'chang rgyal ba lnga'i bdag nyid// ral pa kham nag srid pa'i rtse mor 'phyo// rdzi smin ag tshom drag po'i glog ltar 'khyug

/rnam par 'gyur ba'i bzhin can khro la rngam| |gri gug thod khrag dkrug cing zhal du rol// ral gri rtse gsum phyar gdengs gdug pa sgrol// zhabs gnyis tsan skyil dpa' bo'i dor stabs can// dug chen rnam lnga sku yi rgyan du brjid| |phyag rgya drug ldan pha rol phyin drug rdzogs// stag gi mthang gos dpa' brjid mnyen lcug ldan// mgo rlon khrag rgyun 'bab pa lnga bcu gcig /'du byed lnga bcu dag pas do shal 'phyangs| |sku che yan lag rags shing gsus khyim 'khyil// dbugs bral gdan gyis 'jig tshogs lta ngan 'joms// gtum po'i 'od ldan ma rig mun stug sel// chu skyes sngon pos 'khor ba'i nyes pa spang*// rang 'od me yis nyon mongs bag chags sreg /sku'i nyams gsum 'gro ngor ci yang sprul// gsung gi nyams gsum 'gag med longs spyod rdzogs// thugs kyi nyams gsum spros bral chos kyi sku// sku gsum lhun rdzogs khrag 'thung nag po che// kun rdzob brdar btags bya rog ming can nyid// rdo rje srin po lha chen dpal 'bar gtso// 'jigs byed chen po khyod la bdag bstod do// hūm̐ */ thugs kyi sprul pa srog bdag ka wu wa// sku dang gsung sprul tshe 'chi bya rog gdong*// drag po'i las sgrub bka' yi las mkhan gtso// bsil ba'i tshal bzhugs khyod la bdag bstod do// thugs yum dmar mo dgra bgegs rtsa 'jib ma// dgyes pa bskyed yum dus mtshan nag mo ste// gtum sgeg khro gnyer phyag bzhi mtshon cha gdengs// gsang ba'i yum chen gnyis la bdag bstod do// sha za zhing skyong phyag brnyan 'phrog byed gdong*/ /bya rgod khyung dang khwa dang 'ug pa dang*| |phag dang khyi spyang stag gi gdong pa can// mgyogs ma brlag byed rkos mkhan gsod myos 'gugs// za 'joms mkha' la rgyu ba yid ltar mgyogs// mgo brnyan mkha' 'gro brgyad la bdag bstod do// hūm̐ */

'dul dka' 'dul slad 'jig rten dbang phyug nyid// snying rjes khros pa myur mdzad nag po che// mthing nag phyag drug gri gug phreng ba dang*// thod rnga dung khrag rtse gsum zhags pa 'dzin// li khri'i rtags can mi bskyod cod pan 'chang*// shing la byon te dam can rnal 'byor skyong*// log par rnam 'dren gdan la 'gying stabs can// phyag drug mgon po khyod la bdag bstod do// hūm̐ */ rdo rje gur gyi srung ma mthu rtsal can// dpal ldan nag po chen po khro rngam 'bar// gri gug 'bar bas nyams pa'i tshe srog gcod// yi dwags lhung bzed dmar chen bcud kyis bkang*// rnam 'phrul gaṇ+ḍis nyams pa'i klad pa 'gem// dbugs bral gdan la mi thung gel pa'i stangs// dpal 'bar dbang phyug drag po khro chas can| |gur gyi mgon po che la bdag bstod do// hūm̐ */ 'jam dpal rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor srung ma mchog /ti se'i gangs bzhugs zhing skyong kun gyi gtso// tshad med zhal mnga' dus kyi phyag ldan zhing*// gri gug thod khrag ral gri mdung thung dang*// mi rus phreng ba myos byed bum pa thogs// dung chen lto 'gro gdug pa'i rgyan mang 'phyang*// mi bzad cho 'phrul gnyis skyes la sogs ston// stobs 'phrog nag po che la bdag bstod do// hūm̐ */ tsan+dan beng chen khro gnyer spyan gsum 'bar// smug dang mthing nag sku mdog sna tshogs ston// dar nag ber bklubs drag po'i dbyig pa gdengs// lcags kyi par bur dgra bgegs bla srog 'chang*// sag chen yu ring khra bo zhabs la gsol// dbu skra smin ma sma ra me ltar 'bar// gtum chen rab brjid drag po'i las la dbang*/ /beng 'dzin mgon po che la bdag bstod do// hūm̐ */ lha chen dpal 'bar 'jigs byed kun gyi gtso// mig sman mdog can tri shūl thod snying thogs// ber dang dur khrod chas gsol sna tshogs 'phyang*// las la chas tshe srog bdud drag po'i tshul// rta nag zhon cing stag ral gzig shub thogs// drag po'i spyan gyis brang dang lhu tshigs brgyan// lha srin dregs pa'i tshogs kun las la 'gyed// ma ning nag po'i sku la bdag bstod do// hūm̐ */

nag po chen po che brjid rngam pa'i gzugs| |mun pa ltar gnag spyan gsum khro gnyer g.yo// phyag g.yas gri gug dgra bgegs srog rtsa gcod// g.yon pas dung chen nyams pa'i snying khrag gis// bkang ba la rol stag chen dar ma zhon// za 'og smug khra'i 'jol ber che brjid mnabs// dregs pa 'byung po kun la dbang bsgyur ba// stag zhon mgon po'i sku la bdag bstod do// hūm̐ */ sa brgyad sems pa rin chen mang sprul pa// rnam mang thos sras drag byed chen po ni// bung ba ltar gnag drag po'i spyan dang ldan// phyag g.yas rdo rjes dgra bgegs mgo snying 'joms// g.yon pa pū ris sangs rgyas bstan pa srung*// gdong lnga khros pa'i gdan la rol stabs 'gying*// gnod sbyin drag po 'bum gyi tshogs dang bcas// drag byed rgyal po'i sku la bdag bstod do// hūm̐ */ bka' yi 'khor tshogs las kyi gnyer 'dzin pa// nag po stong ni ka wu wa pa'i gdong*// sha za 'bum ni 'phrog byed rngam pa'i mgo// ma mo bye ba gnod sbyin khri la sogs// sprul pa'i 'khor tshogs rnams la bdag bstod do// hūm̐ */ yang sprul dpal mgon bdun cu dregs pa'i dmag /nying sprul bya gcan sha za 'byung po'i tshogs// gsung sprul dur khrod dregs pa pho mo klu| |rten dang brten par rab bcas tshogs la bstod// phyi nang gsang mchod sman rag gtor mar bcas// dam rdzas mchod pa'i tshogs rnams dgyes rol nas// sangs rgyas bstan srung 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams kyang*// rnal 'byor tshe sring 'dod don dpag med sgrub// bstan gnod phyi nang dgra bgegs drag pos sgrol// bcol ba'i phrin las ma lus 'grub par mdzod// ces bstod/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ phyugs chen mtshon gyis bkums pa'i yan lag mchog gi phreng ba gzhan gyis longs ma spyad pa/ gu gul dang*/ sha chen gyis bdug /oṃ ru tsi ra ma ṇi pra warta ya hūm̐ phaṭa/

ces pa lan bdun gyis sbyangs/ oṃ hrīḥpad+ma narte shwa ri hūm̐/ zhes nyer gcig gis byin gyis brlabs/ slar yang mdud 'dzin bla ma yi dam dbyer med dang*/ phreng rdog rnams ma hā kā lā re rer gsal bar dmigs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ mgon po rnams 'od du zhu ba ngo bo bgrang phreng la rnam pa mi mgo khrag 'dzag pa re re'i rnam par gyur par bsam la/ bzlas pa dngos ni/ bdag bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sa bon las sngags kyi 'od zer 'phros/ mdun gyi ye shes mgon po'i thugs kar pad nyi'i gdan la hūm̐ mthing nag gi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba la phog /sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan sngar ji ltar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dam bca' mi bsnyel ba'i rgyud bskul/ slar mgon po'i zhal nas thon bdag gi zhal du zhugs thugs ka'i sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa la thim pas/ rang nyid gang 'dod pa'i phrin las thams cad mgon pos sgrub par gyur par bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra ka wu wa wa pa ma hā kā lā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pa ni gtso bo'o// slar 'khor la ni/ bdag gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes mgon po'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim pas thugs rgyud bskul/ de las 'od 'phros 'khor thams cad kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i gdan la/ yum gnyis la maṃ re re/ seng gdong la shaṃ/ gzhan 'khor pho thams cad la hūm̐ dang mo thams cad la bh+yo re re'i mthar rang sngags kyis bskor ba la phog /rgyud bskul bdag la dgos pa'i phrin las thams cad thogs med du sgrub par gyur par dmigs la/ oṃ ma hā kā lā gu ṇa hṛ da hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kā lā trak+shad dzaḥ oṃ ma hā kā lā su tri ya ma du dzaḥ bya gdong gsum mo// oṃ hūm̐ shrī de wī kā lī kā lī ma hā kā lī hūm̐ bh+yo dzaḥ yum dmar nag go// oṃ ma hā kā lā singha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭa/ sha za'o// oṃ ghid+da s+ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ga ru ḍa s+yai+ai hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ ka kā s+yai hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ul+lu ka s+yai hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bā rā ha s+yai hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shwa na s+yai hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shriṃ gā la s+yai hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ byā gh+ra s+yai hūm̐ phaṭa/ mkha' 'gro ma brgyad do// oṃ ma hā kā lā k+ṣiṃ k+ṣe tra pā la bigh+nān bi nā ya ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ phyag drug pa'o// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ gur mgon no// oṃ ma hā kā lā kā lā bi kā la rā tri ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhal bzhi pa'o// oṃ ma hā kā lā du beṃ ni dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ beng ngo*// oṃ ma hā kā lā ga ṇa gu h+ya raṃ sid+dhi haṃ'u/ ma ning ngo*// oṃ ma hā kā lā tri yaṃ dzaḥ stag zhon no// oṃ ma hā kā lā bai shra ma ṇā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ drag byed do// oṃ ma hā kā lī hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'khor mo rgyud thams cad do// oṃ karma ma hā kā lā hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho rgyud thams cad do// gtso 'khor thun mong du las 'chol gyi sngags ring ni/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ma hā kā lā ya/ shā sa na u pa hā ri ṇi/ e ṣa a pañtsi ma kā lo a yaṃ i daṃ rat+na tra yā ya/ a pa kā ri ṇaṃ/ ya di pra tidz+nyā sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ duṣ+ṭāṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na/ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa hūm̐/ zhes pa'o/ mdun bskyed bsdu ba'i dmigs pa man ngag ltar mchan| thun mtshams su tshogs kyi mchod pa ni/ thabs kyi rdzas g.yas/ shes rab kyi rdzas g.yon/ zung 'jug gi rdzas dbus su bshams/ bdag gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gsum 'phros pas tshogs rdzas rnams la thim ma thag /raṃ las me byung bas tshogs kyi dngos 'dzin ma dag pa'i nyes skyon thams cad bsregs// yaṃ las rlung byung bas tshogs kyi bag chags kha na ma tho ba'i dri ma thams cad gtor/ khaṃ las chu byung bas gnyis 'dzin 'khrul blo'i nyes pa thams cad sbyangs par dmigs la/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ lan gsum brjod/ slar oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum spros pas/

oṃ gyi 'od zer gyis zhe sdang las gyur pa'i dri ma sbyangs nas tshogs rdzas bdud rtsi dkar por gyur/ āḥyi 'od zer gyis 'dod chags las gyur pa'i dri ma sbyangs nas tshogs rdzas bdud rtsi dmar por gyur/ hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis gti mug las gyur pa'i dri ma sbyangs nas tshogs rdzas bdud rtsi sngon por gyur/ ces dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod/ slar ha hoḥhrīḥzhes brjod pas tshogs kyi 'khor lo sbyang spel sbar bas zag pa med pa'i 'dod yon longs spyod kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ ces dang*/ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum brjod/ tshogs phud gtor mar sgron/ sman raka bran la/ hūm̐ */ bza' dang bca' dang btung ba'i tshogs| |ma tshang med pa'i 'dod yon bcas// kha dog dri ro bcud ldan pa'i/ /tshogs kyi mchod pa rgya chen 'di/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la// brgyud pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i drung*| |gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na// blang dor med par bzhes nas kyang*// dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje yis// zag pa med pa'i dngos grub stsol// hūm̐ */ bza' dang bca' dang btung ba'i tshogs// ma tshang med pa'i 'dod yon bcas// kha dog dri ro bcud ldan pa'i// tshogs kyi mchod pa rgya chen 'di// yi dam dpyid kyi rgyal mo dang*// yum chen rdo rje phag mor bcas// mkha' 'gro mdzes ma dum skyes ma// gzugs can ma sogs 'khor bcas la// gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na// blang dor med par bzhes nas kyang*// dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje yis// zag pa med pa'i dngos grub stsol// hūm̐ */ bza' dang bca' dang btung ba'i tshogs// ma tshang med pa'i 'dod yon bcas// kha dog dri ro bcud ldan pa'i// tshogs kyi mchod pa rgya chen 'di// rdo rje nag po chen po dang*// sku gsung thugs sprul bya rog gdong*// yum chen rtsa 'jib tsaṇ+ḍi ka /seng gdong mkha' 'gro brgyad rnams la// gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na// blang dor med par bzhes nas kyang*// dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje yis// zag pa med pa'i dngos grub stsol// hūm̐ */

bskang ba ni/ hūm̐ */ bskang ngo bskal pas thugs dam bskang*// lha chen ye shes mgon po yi| |thugs dam gnyan po dus 'dir skong*// rta lug g.yag khyi nag po'i tshogs// phyi yi rten gyis thugs dam bskang*// 'dod yon bya rog rgyal mtshan bcas// nang gi rten gyis thugs dam bskang*// gri rgod snying dmar chas su bcug /gsang ba'i rten gyis thugs dam bskang*/ /'bod rbad bsad zlog mnan sreg rdzas/ /mthun pa'i rten gyis thugs dam bskang*| |dar nag bhan+dha rak+ta sogs// rten pa'i rdzas kyis thugs dam bskang*// gser skyems sman raka gtor mar bcas// mchod pa'i rdzas kyis thugs dam bskang*// hūm̐ */ rdo rje srin po'i sprul pa yum/ */seng gdong mkha' 'gro brgyad dang ni// phyag drug gur zhal beng ma ning*// stag zhon drag byed nag po stong*// sha za 'bum dang ma mo bye// gnod sbyin khri sogs sprul pa'i 'khor// dam can srung ma'i tshogs bcas rnams// mthun pa'i rdzas kyis thugs dam bskang*// 'bod pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// g.yab dar nag pos thugs dam bskang*// gshegs pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// dbyangs rnga rol mos thugs dam bskang*// gnas kyi dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// thod mkhar 'bar bas thugs dam bskang*// bzhugs pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// pad nyi ro yi thugs dam bskang*// dgyes pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// bdud rtsi sman gyis thugs dam bskang*// ngom pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// dmar chen rak+tas thugs dam bskang*// tshim pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// dpal gyi gtor mas thugs dam bskang*// mthun pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// sna tshogs nor gyis thugs dam bskang*// rten pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// rten rdzas mang pos thugs dam bskang*// bza' ba'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// sha chen rnam lngas thugs dam bskang*| |btung ba'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// bdud rtsi rnam lngas thugs dam bskang*// mchod pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// phyi nang gsang bas thugs dam bskang*// sku yi thugs dam bskang ba'i phyir// phyag rgya gsal rdzogs thugs dam bskang*// gsung gi thugs dam bskang ba'i phyir// rlung sngags bzlas pas thugs dam bskang*// thugs kyi thugs dam bskang ba'i phyir| |ting 'dzin brtan pas thugs dam bskang*// yon tan thugs dam bskang ba'i phyir// 'dod yon 'byor pas thugs dam bskang*// phrin las thugs dam bskang ba'i phyir// las sbyor 'bad pas thugs dam bskang*// bskang ngo gsol lo mchod par bgyi// thugs dam skong la dngos grub stsol// ces brjod/

bshags pa bya ba ni/ hoḥ lha chen rdo rje srin po sprul 'khor yum| |nag po mched bdun dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs// khyed rnams ye nas mngon par sangs rgyas kyang*// gdug pa 'dul slad drag po'i skur bstan pa// ye shes spyan ldan dus gsum mkhyen cing gzigs// legs nyes stangs gcod dam tshig bya ra byed// bdag cag blun rmongs ma rig 'khrul pa yi// las dang nyon mongs bag chags kyis dkrugs pas// nag po chen po bsgrub par dam bcas kyang*// sku'i phyag rgya ma gsal don ma rtogs// sngags kyi bzlas brjod ma dag chad lhag 'khrul// yid kyi ting 'dzin bying rgod rtog pas slad// dam rdzas ma tshang rten rdzas ma 'tshog dang*// rgyu chung phud nyams 'bag btsog dri mas gos// dus kyi mchod gtor 'gyang zhing chag pa dang*// bsnyen sgrub g.yel zhing las sbyor skyengs dred 'dzol// cho ga lhag chad ma 'byor ma rnyed sogs// rtsa ba sbom po yan lag dam las 'gal// mdor na dam can srung ma khyed rnams kyi// sku gsung thugs dang 'gal ba ci mchis pa// rang gnong 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags// mthol bshags bzod pa dang du bzhes nas kyang*// 'phral dang yun gyi sgrib par mi 'gyur bar// tshangs zhing bzod pas dngos grub bdag la stsol// oṃ shrī badz+ra ma hā kā lā sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ sogs yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod/ kha na ma tho zhing tha mal pa'i kun tu spyod pa med par tshogs la longs spyad/ lhag ma bsdus par sman dang rak+ta bran/ me sgron btsugs la/ a kā ro lan gsum dang*/ hoḥ dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tshogs kyi// bka' nyan lhag mar dbang ba'i 'khor// ging dang laṅka pho nya'i tshogs// dregs pa sha za yi dwags gdon// 'byung po ma sring grangs med tshogs// sha la 'ga' bas sha la zo// khrag la dgyes pas khrag la 'thung*// rus la dgyes pas rus la mur// chang la dgyes pas myos byed rol// bza' dang bca' dang btung ba'i tshogs// 'dod dgu'i longs spyod 'di bzhes la// rdo rje srin po'i bka' ma bcag

/rnal 'byor bdag gi dam ma 'dral| |bstan la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs dang*// bdag la sdang ba'i nyes byed dang*// lha la dmod pa'i ma rungs dang*// dam la ldog pa'i dam nyams dang*// mtshams med pa yi sdig can sogs// bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur pa rnams// skad cig nyid la bkug nas kyang*// gsod gtub sha khrag rus par bcas// dregs pa rnams kyi rngams zas gyis// bcol ba'i las kun khyod kyis sgrubs// oṃ ma hā kā lā u ts+tshiṣ+ṭa pa ti sarba kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes gtsang sar dor ro// las sbyor gtor zlog /srung zlog /bsad pa/ sreg mnan/ 'phang ba sogs las rab 'byams sgrub pa rnams 'dir bya ba yin no// thun mthar gtor ma drag por 'phang ba sogs ni mgon po brgyad kyi dngos grub srung zlog man ngag dgra bgegs nges par 'joms par byed pa gnam lcags 'bar ba'i mtshon char bshad pa ltar byas la/ 'dir ni bsnyen sgrub dus gtor sogs kyi skabs thun mthar gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ thun gyi gtor ma ong skyu mang pos bskor ba sha khrag gis brgyan pa me dmar dang ldan pa stegs kyi khar bshams/ rak+ta bran la 'gugs dbye lan gsum sogs byas rjes/ sman raka bran/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ las 'chol sngags ring gi mthar/ i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum bdun nyer gcig sogs long skabs bstun pas dngos su 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐ */ rang bzhin gnas dang 'og min chos kyi dbyings// gnas dang yul chen dur khrod che rnams nas// rdo rje nag po chen po mched brgyad po// rang rang yum dang sprul 'khor bcas pa rnams| |skad cig nyid la sgrub mchod gnas 'dir gshegs// mthun pa'i dam rdzas sman raka gtor ma dang*// dgra bgegs sha khrag 'dod yon mkho dgu'i rdzas// ma tshang med pa byin gyi brlabs pa 'di// lha chen ma hā kā lā'i tshogs la 'bul// sngar bcol las bsgrubs gtang rag gnyan po 'bul// phyi bcol las kyi zhu skyems dag kyang 'di// da bcol las kyi gnyer zas dam par bsngo// bzhes shig rol cig snoms shig nag po'i tshogs// sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blangs shing*// da lta rnal 'byor bdag gi bcol ba'i las// sangs rgyas bstan srungs dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod// dge 'dun sde skyongs rnal 'byor tshe srog srings// sdang ba'i dgra sod gnod pa'i bgegs dpung thul// bdag 'dod 'bras bu dus 'dir mchis par mdzod// ces thog steng sogs gtsang sar ram lho nub mtshams su 'bul/

gtang rag tu/ oṃ aṣ+ṭa ma hā kā lā sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ hūm̐ */ dpal ldan ma hā kā lā nag po brgyad// bstan srung tshogs kyis bskor ba'i mthu stobs can// phyogs bcur rgyu ba'i ma rungs sems ldan rnams// ma lus tshar gcod mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod| |ces dang*/ bdag gis ma 'byor ma rnyed sogs// nongs pa'i dri ma gang mchis pa// de kun 'gyod pas bshags bgyid na// bzod par bzhes la tshangs par mdzod// ces dang yig brgya brjod/ nub tha ma yin na/ oṃ/ rdo rje nag po chen po'i tshogs// 'dir gshegs bdag 'dod bskangs zin gyi// rang rang gnas su gshegs nas kyang*// gang tshe spyan drangs myur 'byon gsol| |oṃ aṣ+ṭa badz+ra ma hā kā lā sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra muḥ ye shes kyi mgon po mched brgyad spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa srung 'khor dur khrod gzhal yas khang rnams 'khor rnams la thim/ 'khor rnams mgon po brgyad la thim/ de rnams gtso bo la thim/ gtso bo thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ yig rang gi srog rtsol nang du 'jug pa dang lhan cig rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim par gyur par bsam/ shis brjod dang bsngo ba smon lam byin chags par bya zhing*/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya/ bris 'bur gyi sku'i rten yod na/ dam ye lhan cig de dag la bstims shing brtan bzhugs bya'o// smras pa/ rgyal kun bstan srung rdo rje nag po che// brgyad kyi las rim phrin las 'dod 'jo zhes// tshig don rnam bkra rgyas bsdus 'tsham pa ste// chos kyi grags pas legs bshad lang tsho ngom// 'di ni gnas skabs mthar thug thams cad kyi// sa dang lam gyi bar gcod bsrung ba dang*// zhing bcu tshar gcod bstan pa bsrung ba la// gces par 'dzin cing nyams su blang byar rigs// blo gros lang tsho rgud ba'i mdza' na mo// rig lam du ma'i rgyan mang mi ldan par// legs bshad zur mig g.yo ba'i blo ldan gzhan// mdza'
